# uptimepage_alert_source (Resource)

An alert source: a URL that Prometheus Alertmanager, Grafana, Datadog or a script posts its alerts to. A firing alert opens an incident that pages through the source's escalation policy, the organization default, or its channels, and the tool's recovery closes it. Needs a plan with alert sources. Deleting it stops the URL at once and resolves the incidents it holds open.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimepage_notification_channel" "ops" {
  name = "ops slack"
  config = {
    type  = "slack"
    slack = { webhook_url = var.slack_webhook_url }
  }
}

# Alertmanager posts its alert groups here; one group is one incident, and
# its recovery closes it. Give each team's receiver a source of its own.
resource "uptimepage_alert_source" "prometheus" {
  name   = "prod alertmanager"
  kind   = "alertmanager"
  alerts = [{ channel_id = uptimepage_notification_channel.ops.id }]
}

# A Grafana contact point that signs what it sends. The secret is write-only
# (Terraform 1.11+): bump the version to rotate it.
resource "uptimepage_alert_source" "grafana" {
  name                      = "prod grafana"
  kind                      = "grafana"
  escalation_policy_id      = var.oncall_policy_id
  signing_secret_wo         = var.grafana_signing_secret
  signing_secret_wo_version = 1
}

# Hand the URL to the tool's own configuration; it is the source's credential.
output "alertmanager_webhook_url" {
  value     = uptimepage_alert_source.prometheus.ingest_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) The tool that posts: `alertmanager`, `grafana`, `datadog`, or `generic` for a script. Fixed at create, so a change replaces the source: its URL stops, the incidents it holds open are resolved, and a policy bound in the app is not carried over. Replacing needs `alert_sources:delete`.
- `name` (String) Source name, unique in the organization, at most 100 characters after trimming. Incidents and pages name it.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `alerts` (Attributes List) Notification channels the source's incidents page when no escalation policy applies, neither its own nor the organization default. Terraform owns the list, so a channel bound in the app is removed on the next apply. A source must reach someone, so with no policy and no enabled channel the API refuses it with 422 ALERT_SOURCE_NO_ROUTE. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alerts))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Off pauses the source: a firing opens nothing and the tool still gets a 202, while a recovery still closes. Nothing is queued, so an alert still firing on resume opens on its next repeat.
- `escalation_policy_id` (String) Escalation policy the source's incidents page (UUID, from the policy's page in the app). Binding or changing it needs a token of an organization owner with `oncall:write`. Leave it out to bind the policy in the app instead, or to page the organization default policy or the source's channels; removing the line keeps the binding it set.
- `grouping` (String) `group` (the default) opens one incident per alert group the tool sends, so a failure across many hosts pages once; `alert` opens one per alert. It can change only while the source holds no open incident (409 ALERT_SOURCE_GROUPING_LOCKED otherwise).
- `notify_recovery` (Boolean) Whether the people paged hear when the tool's recovery closes the incident.
- `renotify_interval_secs` (Number) Seconds before the first reminder while an incident stays unacknowledged; each further reminder waits twice as long, up to a day. 0 turns reminders off; otherwise at least 60.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Grafana only: the HMAC secret its contact point signs with, 16 to 256 characters, persisted to Terraform state. On Terraform 1.11+ prefer signing_secret_wo. Once set, unsigned requests are refused. Leave it out to set the secret in the app; removing the line keeps the secret, so remove it in the app to stop checking signatures. The API never returns the secret: one removed in the app is sent again on the next apply, but one replaced in the app is not detected.
- `signing_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only signing secret (Terraform 1.11+): sent to the API on apply, never persisted to state or plan. Set signing_secret_wo_version alongside and bump it to rotate.
- `signing_secret_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for signing_secret_wo. The secret itself never diffs, so bump this when it changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Alert source id (UUID).
- `ingest_token` (String, Sensitive) The same token, for a tool that sends it as `Authorization: Bearer` to `/hooks/alerts`, which keeps it out of URLs the tool shows in plain text.
- `ingest_url` (String, Sensitive) Where the tool posts, with the token in the path. A rotation in the app changes it, and the old URL keeps working for 24 hours. The API withholds it from a token without `alert_sources:write` and after the server's encryption key was rotated; the last value read is kept then, so refresh with a write token after a rotation.

- `channel_id` (String) Notification channel id (lowercase UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing source by its UUID, the last part of its page URL in the
# app. A signing secret never comes back from the API, so set it in config.
terraform import uptimepage_alert_source.prometheus 0192f3a4-5b6c-7d8e-9f01-23456789abcd
```
